content.value_statement: Teams need a clear path from AI idea to deployable system. This skill organizes LLM, RAG, agent, MLOps, observability, and security work.
actual_capabilities: Break AI delivery into design, integration, retrieval, agent, pipeline, observability, and security phases.
Suggest related specialized skills for LLM applications, RAG systems, agents, MLOps, and evaluation.
Provide copy-paste prompts for invoking focused AI and machine learning skills.
List practical action steps for each workflow phase.
Offer checklists for LLM integration, RAG systems, agents, observability, and quality gates.
limitations: Does not implement models, APIs, vector databases, or deployment infrastructure directly.
Requires separate validation against project requirements, data policies, and runtime constraints.
Depends on referenced skills being available in the user environment.
Does not replace security review, model evaluation, or production readiness testing.

use_cases.title: Plan an AI Product Build
use_cases.description: Map a product idea into phases for model choice, architecture, data flow, and success metrics.

use_cases.title: Coordinate RAG Development
use_cases.description: Organize embedding, vector database, retrieval, reranking, caching, and evaluation work for a knowledge assistant.

use_cases.title: Prepare ML Operations
use_cases.description: Plan pipeline design, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and quality gates for production ML.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starting Phase
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new AI feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this AI and ML workflow to identify the first three phases for my project. My goal is: [describe goal].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a RAG Assistant
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a retrieval system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to create a RAG implementation plan for [domain]. Include data pipeline, embeddings, vector search, and evaluation tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Design Agent Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to design an AI agent system for [workflow]. Define roles, tools, memory, orchestration, and human review points.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to review production readiness for my AI system. Cover observability, security, evaluation, costs, and quality gates.

output_examples.input: Plan a customer support assistant with internal documentation search.
output: Recommended phases: AI application design, LLM integration, RAG implementation, observability, and AI security.
Key tasks: define success metrics, prepare documents, choose embeddings, configure retrieval, test answers, and monitor costs.
Suggested next skills: AI product planning, RAG engineering, vector database setup, LLM evaluation, and prompt security.

output_examples.input: Create a workflow for a multi-agent research assistant.
output: Recommended phases: application design, agent development, LLM integration, observability, and security review.
Key tasks: define agent roles, choose orchestration, add tool boundaries, configure memory, and require human approval for sensitive actions.

output_examples.input: Prepare an ML pipeline for production deployment.
output: Recommended phases: ML pipeline development, observability, quality gates, and AI security.
Key tasks: build data processing, train models, create evaluation checks, register models, deploy safely, and monitor performance.

best_practices: Start with clear success metrics before choosing models, frameworks, or data stores.
Add evaluation, tracing, cost monitoring, and safety checks before production launch.
Use the referenced specialist skills only when their scope matches the current task.
anti_patterns: Do not skip validation because the workflow names a recommended phase.
Do not deploy agent tools without permissions, audit logs, and human review for sensitive actions.
Do not treat prompt examples as complete implementation guidance for a production system.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps plan AI applications, RAG systems, agents, ML pipelines, observability, and security work.

faq.question: Does it write production code?
faq.answer: No. It organizes the workflow and points to specialist skills that may support implementation tasks.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful for RAG projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes phases for data pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval, reranking, caching, and evaluation.

faq.question: Does it cover AI safety and security?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes steps for input validation, output filtering, rate limits, access controls, monitoring, and audit logging.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare the project goal, target users, data sources, model constraints, deployment environment, and success criteria.
